anomalies.observed: The TPS62933 (U1) feedback network in the Power Train block is drawn with R14 = 5.23 kΩ from the +5V output node to the FB pin (U1.8) and R15 = 10 kΩ from FB to GND, i.e. a top/bottom ratio of only 0.523.
anomalies.expected: The specification states U1 is a '24 V → 5 V synchronous buck regulator, 3 A'. With the TPS62933's 0.8 V feedback reference, a 5 V output requires a divider ratio of about 5.25 (e.g. R14 = 52.3 kΩ with R15 = 10 kΩ, or R15 = 1 kΩ with R14 = 5.23 kΩ). The drawn 5.23 kΩ / 10 kΩ pair programs roughly 1.2 V.

evidence.quote: 24V→5V 3A BUCK / U1 TPS62933 ... R14 5.23k ... R15 10k (Power Train, sheet 1)
U1 — TPS62933 (TI) | 24 V → 5 V synchronous buck regulator, 3 A

anomalies.impact: The main +5 V rail would regulate to about 1.2 V instead of 5 V, so the ESP32-C6 DevKit (5V0 pin), the AZ1117-3.3 LDO and the TMC2209 logic supply would all be under-voltage and the board would not boot.

anomalies.observed: In the Safety Switches block of the Water Level Sensor/Switches sheet, the 10 kΩ pull-up to +3V3 (R6) is on the upper net that carries the FLOAT_HIGH label, and the 10 kΩ pull-down to GND (R9) is on the lower net that carries the FLOAT_LOW label.
anomalies.expected: The specification places them the other way round: R6 is the 10 kΩ pull-up on FLOAT_LOW and R9 is the 10 kΩ pull-down on FLOAT_HIGH.

evidence.quote: +3V3 → R6 10k → FLOAT_HIGH ; FLOAT_LOW → R9 10k → GND (Water Level Sensor/Switches, sheet 1)

anomalies.impact: FLOAT_HIGH would idle high (turning T4 on permanently and holding the ATO valve closed) and FLOAT_LOW would idle low, so the low-level pump cut-out and high-level overflow interlocks act with inverted polarity and the automatic top-off valve can never be opened.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the specified design in the power train and in the float-switch bias network: the TPS62933 feedback divider (R14/R15) is a factor of ten off and would program the main +5 V rail to roughly 1.2 V, and the float pull resistors R6/R9 appear to be attached to the opposite float nets from those given in the specification.
